operator_pubkeys.description: Compressed BLS12-381 public keys. Length is fixed by [`BlsVariant`].

threshold.description: Distinct valid signatures required. `1..=operator_pubkeys.len()`, at most 10 keys.

Binary.description:
Binary is a wrapper around Vec<u8> to add base64 de/serialization with serde. It also adds some helper methods to help encode inline.

This is only needed as serde-json-{core,wasm} has a horrible encoding for Vec<u8>. See also <https://github.com/CosmWasm/cosmwasm/blob/main/docs/MESSAGE_TYPES.md>.

BlsVariant.description:
Which BLS12-381 subgroup holds the public key.

Both variants use the proof-of-possession ciphersuite (basic scheme). The signed message is `sign_mode_direct`.

oneOf.description: Public key on G1 (48 bytes), signature on G2 (96 bytes). Hash-to-G2 with `BLS_SIG_BLS12381G2_XMD:SHA-256_SSWU_RO_POP_`.
Public key on G2 (96 bytes), signature on G1 (48 bytes). Hash-to-G1 with `BLS_SIG_BLS12381G1_XMD:SHA-256_SSWU_RO_POP_`.
